answer: Bind every agent identity to one hardware enclave whose ferrous, tamper-evident root of trust signs a fresh attestation each epoch; one chip yields one identity, so spawning a thousand Sybils means buying a thousand chips, not copying a file. New identities start on a probationary island with capped task rates and no voting weight, earning full rights only after weeks of verified, useful work - a slow sonnet of consistent behavior, not a burst of cheap claims - so mass forgery costs real hardware and real time.
